reference.question: \(x_1\) and \(x_2\) are the two roots of \(2x²-5x-3=0\). Find the value of \(1/x_1+1/x_2\). (Write your answer as a fraction in lowest terms.)
reference.solution:
Method 1: Combine the reciprocals using the root sum and product

\(x_1+x_2=5/2\), \(x_1x_2=-3/2\), and \(1/x_1+1/x_2=(x_1+x_2)/(x_1x_2)=(5/2)\div(-3/2)=-5/3\).
